name: векторы: сдвиг, между точками, поворот, отражение, круг, atan2, warp, ловушка v * 2
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph01") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    o = loc(0, 0, 0)
    full = get_coordinate(shift_location_on_vector(o, vec(0, 3, 0)), type: y)
    part = get_coordinate(shift_location_on_vector(o, vec(0, 3, 0), 1), type: y)
    between = get_vector_between_locations(loc(1, 0, 0), loc(4, 4, 0))
    send_message("ph01 сдвиг=${full} ${part} длина=${get_vector_length(between)}")
    get_vector_all_components(between, bx, by, bz)
    send_message("ph01 из a в b=${bx} ${by} ${bz}")
    get_vector_all_components(rotate_vector_around_axis(vec(0, 0, 1), 90, axis: y), lx, ly, lz)
    send_message("ph01 поворот=${round(lx)} ${round(lz)}")
    get_vector_all_components(reflect_vector_product(vec(1, -1, 0), vec(0, 1, 0), 0.5), rx, ry, rz)
    send_message("ph01 отражение=${rx} ${ry}")
    a = 90
    get_vector_all_components(vec(2 * cos(a), 0, 2 * sin(a)), ox, oy, oz)
    send_message("ph01 круг=${round(ox)} ${round(oz)}")
    turn = atan2(1, 1)
    send_message("ph01 atan2=${round(turn, 2)}")
    send_message("ph01 обёртка=${warp(350, -180, 180)}")
    twice = multiply_vector(between, 2)
    get_vector_all_components(twice, tx, ty, tz)
    wrong = between * 2
    send_message("ph01 умножение=${tx} формула=${wrong}")
}

name: поворот: стороны по yaw, вперёд по земле, влево, sideways, угол из направления
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph02") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    get_vector_all_components(value.direction_of_view, dx, dy, dz)
    ahead = rotate_vector_around_axis(vec(0, 0, 1), -value.yaw, axis: y)
    get_vector_all_components(ahead, fx, fy, fz)
    left = rotate_vector_around_axis(ahead, 90, axis: y)
    get_vector_all_components(left, lx, ly, lz)
    side = shift_location_in_direction(value.location, 1, direction: sideways)
    get_vector_all_components(get_vector_between_locations(value.location, side), sx, sy, sz)
    send_message("ph02 взгляд=${round(dx)} ${round(dz)} вперёд=${round(fx)} ${round(fz)} влево=${round(lx)} ${round(lz)} вбок=${round(sx)} ${round(sz)}")
    east = shift_coordinate(value.location, 5, type: x)
    face = get_coordinate(var.face_location(value.location, east), type: yaw)
    aim = get_coordinate(set_location_direction(value.location, vec(1, 0, 0)), type: yaw)
    tilt = get_angle_between_vectors(value.direction_of_view, ahead)
    send_message("ph02 восток=${round(face)} ${round(aim)} наклон=${round(tilt)}")
}

name: толчки игрока: increment, порядок, высота; value.velocity не видит ходьбу
code:
func ph03_show(label: text) {
    get_vector_all_components(value.velocity, vx, vy, vz)
    send_message("ph03 ${label} y=${round(vy, 2)} z=${round(vz, 2)}")
}

process ph03_walk() {
    wait(10)
    was = value.location
    wait(10)
    walked = locations_distance(was, value.location, type: two_d)
    seen = get_vector_length(set_vector_component(value.velocity, 0, vector_component: y))
    send_message("ph03 прошёл=${round(walked)} внешняя=${round(seen, 1)}")
}

when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph03") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    player.launch_up(0.5, increment: false)
    ph03_show("вверх")
    wait(30)
    player.launch_up(0.3, increment: false)
    player.launch_up(0.3)
    ph03_show("сумма")
    wait(30)
    player.launch_up(0.5, increment: false)
    player.launch_forward(0.4, increment: false, launch_axis: yaw)
    ph03_show("стёрло")
    wait(30)
    player.launch_forward(0.4, increment: false, launch_axis: yaw)
    player.launch_up(0.5)
    ph03_show("порядок")
    wait(30)
    y0 = value.y_coordinate
    player.launch_up(1, increment: false)
    wait(12)
    send_message("ph03 высота=${round(value.y_coordinate - y0)}")
}

when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph03w") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    start ph03_walk()
}

name: рывок: один толчок против вектора каждый тик
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph05") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    home = value.location
    dir = rotate_vector_around_axis(vec(0, 0, 1), -value.yaw, axis: y)
    back = multiply_vector(dir, -1)
    player.launch_forward(1, increment: false, launch_axis: yaw)
    wait(20)
    one = locations_distance(home, value.location, type: two_d)
    was = value.location
    repeat 5 {
        set_velocity(back, increment: false)
        wait(1)
    }
    wait(15)
    many = locations_distance(was, value.location, type: two_d)
    send_message("ph05 толчок=${round(one)} рывок=${round(many)}")
    player.teleport(home)
}

name: двойной прыжок на клавишах: нажатие в воздухе, один раз, сброс на земле
двойной прыжок через полёт: разрешение после отрыва, два нажатия в воздухе
отскок от стены: один луч даёт точку и грань
code:
func ph08_wall_jump() {
    hit = ray_trace_result(variable_for_hit_block_face: face, start: value.eye_location, max_distance: 1.5, ray_size: 0, ray_collision_mode: only_blocks)
    if is_on_ground() or not var.is_type(hit, location) {
        send_message("ph08 нет стены")
        return
    }
    normal = get_vector_from_block_face(face)
    get_vector_all_components(normal, nx, ny, nz)
    push = multiply_vector(normal, 0.6)
    set_velocity(push + vec(0, 0.5, 0), increment: false)
    send_message("ph08 грань=${face} нормаль=${round(nx)} ${round(nz)}")
}

when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph08") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    wall = shift_location_in_direction(value.eye_location, 1, direction: forward)
    low = shift_coordinate(wall, -1, type: y)
    high = shift_coordinate(wall, 1, type: y)
    set_block([low, wall, high], block(stone))
    wait(2)
    player.launch_up(0.42, increment: false)
    wait(3)
    z0 = value.z_coordinate
    ph08_wall_jump()
    wait(6)
    send_message("ph08 отошёл=${round(z0 - value.z_coordinate)}")
    set_block([low, wall, high], block(air))
    wait(20)
    send_message("ph08 убрано")
}

name: гравитация атрибутом: лунный прыжок и возврат
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@ph09") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    y0 = value.y_coordinate
    player.launch_up(0.5, increment: false)
    wait(16)
    plain = value.y_coordinate - y0
    wait(10)
    player.set_attribute(0.02, attribute_type: generic_gravity)
    y0 = value.y_coordinate
    player.launch_up(0.5, increment: false)
    wait(14)
    moon = value.y_coordinate - y0
    player.set_attribute(0.08, attribute_type: generic_gravity)
    send_message("ph09 обычная=${round(plain)} лунная=${round(moon)}")
    wait(30)
    player.heal(20)
    send_message("ph09 убрано")
}
